title: Vegetarian Algerian Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African dish made with a variety of vegetables and spices, all slow-cooked in a traditional clay pot.
instructions: Heat the zero-calorie oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and zucchini, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, chicken broth, and algerian tagine spice blend.
Stir to combine, then bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
